Subject: SOC 2 Type II report request — audit period, bridge letter options, and starter bundle

Hi Lucy / Acme security team,

Thanks for the heads-up on the security review. To move this forward quickly, can you confirm the audit window you need coverage for (example: 2025-01-01 — 2025-12-31)? Our SOC 2 Type II report and supporting starter bundle are ready to share once we confirm the period and preferred transfer mechanism.

What we can provide immediately as a minimal starter bundle:
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) covering the validated period
- Short bridge letter (if you need an interim statement)
- Control mapping snapshot (CSV/XLSX) showing which controls map to SIG/CAIQ attributes
- Short summaries: log retention, encryption at rest, KMS integration, user access review cadence
- Sample redaction guidance if you need PII removed before transfer

Transfer options we support: presigned S3 link (preferred for large bundles), secure SharePoint link via our Customer Portal, or a secure SFTP. We can also send a sealed DocuSign acknowledgment for the bridge letter if that helps procurement.

If you want a canned reply for procurement, use this one-liner to request: "Please share Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report for audit period [YYYY-MM-DD to YYYY-MM-DD] and indicate whether a bridge letter is acceptable. Request presigned S3 transfer."

Next steps (proposed):
1) You confirm audit window and transfer method.
2) We prepare minimal starter bundle and provide presigned links.
3) You confirm receipt and any redaction requirements.

Happy to hop on a 15-minute call if you want to run through specifics.

Best,
Marissa
Sr. Manager, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request — audit period, bridge letter options, and starter bundle

Thanks Marissa — quick answers below.

Audit window: we need coverage for 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31.
Transfer: presigned S3 link preferred.
Bridge letter: procurement prefers an explicit bridge letter if the report date is older than 12 months; please include the standard language about scope and any notable exceptions.
Redaction: we typically accept unredacted reports from vendors; if you prefer to redact, call out what was redacted.

Can you also include a short control mapping to SOC/CC1 and answers to these two quick questions for our intake form: 
1) Does Redwood retain customer request logs longer than 90 days?
2) Where are encryption keys stored (KMS provider)?

If you can send the presigned link and the bridge letter draft by EOD tomorrow that would be great.

Lucy
Sr. Procurement Manager
Acme Corp
